$Comment: The gameplay of zc's dungeon template: the game's Default_Instance (no world events) where nobody places or gathers a block and only a creative-mode player breaks one, so every area pastes back clean for the next party; and a player who dies respawns at the world's spawn provider, which puts each player back in their own area. Default_Instance itself sends the dead out of the instance. AllowBlockBreaking is true because the game refuses every break while it is false, creative ones included; Plugin.ZigBlockRules.CreativeOnlyBreaking then refuses every other breaker (survival and adventure players, NPCs, explosions) before the block takes damage, and keeps a block-group cycling tool to creative. Set CreativeOnlyBreaking false to let everybody break, or AllowBlockBreaking false to let nobody. A World group replaces the parent's whole group rather than adding to it, so all three block switches are written here; a Plugin group merges over the parent's. A dungeon whose template names another gameplay config keeps that one's rules, and gets this one by writing the same ZigBlockRules group or by naming this config as its Parent.
